responses.text: {Player not in NCR gear} This post isn't someplace a civilian ought to be.
{Player in NCR gear} You a transfer from one of the other posts? I haven't seen you around before.
You're really not supposed to be here.
Just the usual. Legion scouts try to slip across the river a couple times a week, but they always end up floating downriver with holes in their heads.
{Player in NCR gear} Oh, right. She radioed ahead and mentioned that somebody was coming by.
Oh, right. She radioed ahead and mentioned that somebody was coming by. Odd that she'd send a civilian instead of a trooper, though.

topics.prompt: Sergeant Reyes at Camp Forlorn Hope sent me with a security update for your radio.

responses.text: Ranger Station Alpha. Ranger Lineholm is in command here.
I'm not really much of a historian. The short version is that the Rangers are the elite of the NCR military. Best fighters in the wasteland.
